title: A Weather for the Blue Hour
author: Coral Amberdale
blurb: Quentin Zhou, an heir cataloging a parent's silence after the funeral, has perfected the smile that ends conversations. Then the last speaker of a language asks for one final student — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, they must return to the place where the story went wrong before the demolition date arrives.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
